checked.found: Traditional dating c. 30-33 CE; 30 is the start of the window.
Mani's second revelation at age 24 is dated 240-241 (first, at 12, 228-229); public mission begins then.

No source gives a founding year. 767 is the year the Jewish Encyclopedia gives for Anan's arrest after the exilarch dispute; Britannica says only that he became prominent in the 760s. Whether he founded Karaism at all is debated.
Britannica: propagation of the new religion began in Cairo in 1017; Hamza's earliest dated epistle is July 1017.
Bruno and six companions settled in the Chartreuse mountains in 1084; Britannica dates the order 1084.
Cîteaux inaugurated 21 March 1098 by Robert of Molesme and Benedictine monks who wanted a stricter Rule, on marshland near Dijon.
Sources give 1118 or 1119 (Britannica: late 1119 or early 1120); 1119 is the common date. Hugues de Payens, a French knight, and companions vowed to protect pilgrims.
1173 is the most commonly cited date; some sources give 1177 or a 1170-1177 range.
Honorius III confirmed the Order of Preachers by the bull Religiosam vitam, 22 December 1216 (Wikipedia also lists 1215 for the local founding).

Most sources put Smyth's self-baptism in Amsterdam in 1609 (a few say 1608). Helwys's 1611-12 congregation is the first on English soil, so 'first of its kind' is acceptable as the first Baptist congregation.
Schism over strict shunning and discipline in 1693, between Ammann and Swiss Mennonite leaders such as Hans Reist.
24 May 1738 at a meeting on Aldersgate Street, London; Wesley felt his heart strangely warmed and an assurance of salvation.
Ann Lee and eight followers reached New York City on 6 August 1774; settlement at Watervliet followed in 1776.
Church of Christ organised 6 April 1830 (Fayette per the church; some early accounts say Manchester, New York).
Massachusetts charter for the Church of Christ (Scientist), Boston, 1879 (23 August); the association voted to organise it on 12 April 1879.
Began April 1906 (9 April on Bonnie Brae Street; services at Azusa Street from 14 April), with speaking in tongues.
Haile Selassie crowned 2 November 1930; Jamaican preachers (Howell, Dunkley, Hibbert) proclaimed his divinity. Sources say Rastafari emerged after the coronation.
Archbishop Perier erected it as a diocesan congregation on 7 October 1950 (pontifical right 1965). 'Won approval' is accurate for diocesan approval.
Founded Walpurgisnacht (30 April) 1966 per Wikipedia and Britannica (EBSCO notes the date is disputed); LaVey declared 'Year One'. The phrase 'proclaimed a new year' states no date.
